reviews.text: The entire team was extremely friendly and treated my dog Mouse with so much care and kindness. He has cancer and they were very compassionate and clear about all of his options. I will be using them for anything else I need in the future.
They took amazing care of coco with her allergies and infections definitely the go to spot if your pet needs help
I am very happy with the care and advice provided by the Veterinary Technicians and Dr. Culjat-Vukman.
Always caring and kind to their patients and owners alike.

Such a positive experience for both myself and my dog Oakley! The staff were extremely friendly, welcoming and professional. The clinic has such a great vibe , the location is convenient and in a great area. The vet/ doctor was extremely knowledgeable, very patient, and gentle , she took the time to clearly explain everything to me. Oakley was also so at ease,  it’s evident that animals are her passion, and this is her calling! . Again an exceptional experience, would highly recommend this Clinic!!
Very accommodating staff.
Good people. Good care.
I find them very emotionally invested in the well being of all the animals I have seen there, not only mine.  They don’t push extra services. I recommend them.
We get the best service and care with this team. They have helped us through those tough decisions we have as pet owners and celebrated new arrivals. Highly recommended  Dr Delgado and her team

The staff are great and accommodating. I appreciated them also going over the fees and what to expect.
My cat is fine after two surgeries from Kingston Road Animal Hospital.
Wil not hesitate to use them again.
The team always takes good care of our pet, with patience and compassion.
Have been seeing Dr Delgado and her team for years. They are knowledge, thoughtful, and caring. They always take my perspective in mind and genuinely care about my dog’s wellbeing. Love them!

I have been taking my cat to Kingston Road Animal Hospital for 3 years. Recently he was diagnosed with diabetes. Caitlin, the technician, has been wonderful in caring for him and follows up immediately and to check in. The vets, Dr.Delgado and Dr. Culjat-Vukman and are also very good.

I was extremely pleased with the attentive care i received after our cockapoo got sprayed by a skunk and our own vet was  unable to accommodate. The vet tech and vet were   Very compassionate and knowledgeable. Reassured and spent considerable time with Darcy and me. I liked the small feel of the clinic. Receptionist helpful in getting us a quick appt. Thank you for great service! Jane
Very caring
Very caring, thorough with a clearly explained diagnosis. We are a long term client.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! ⭐❤️ We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. It’s always our goal to provide compassionate, personalized care to every pet and their family. Thank you for being part of our Kingston Road Animal Hospital family! 🐾💕

-KRAH TEAM-

I got the chance to get an emergency appointment for my dog and I cannot be happier and satisfied of the incredible service provided by Kingston Road Animal Hospital. As soon as we got there, the team took care of my dog making her feeling loved and appreciated. They even took the time to spend time with her on the ground so she will adapt easily - This was never done from her current veterinary and, to be honest, I am thinking on changing vets as I felt understood, listened and all my worries were dispersed with their incredible service. I will definitely recommend to my friends and neighbourhood.

We love the KRAH team!!! Hardworking, kind, and responsive, we definitely recommend. Special thank you to Dr.Delgado and Kylo’s VERY faves Caitlin and Jess❤️ for always taking such good care of him. We appreciate you! Thank you Kingston Road Animal Hospital!
Much love,
Ivana and Kylo

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to share your experience. It means so much to our team, and we look forward to caring for you and Comet again in the future! 🐾💙
Hope Comet feels better!

-KRAH TEAM-

I had an emergency with my dog Shelby and I was told to bring her in right away. I picked Shelby up a few hours later, ready to go. I’ve had several visits in the past year and we have both been treated very well.

We always have a great experience at Kingston Road Animal Hospital. Dr. Laura was very kind and thorough, and the staff are always friendly, welcoming, and caring. Everyone genuinely seems to love animals, and Zoe is always treated so well. Thank you to the whole team! 🐾 …
My dog is so skittish and afraid of the vet but they were so patient and good with her. Highly recommend!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your support means a great deal to our team. We're grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet and look forward to seeing you both again at Kingston Road Animal Hospital. 🐾💙 …
The Dr was very kind and informative. I appreciated the patience and care taken with my girl
We’ve been taking Freddie to Kingston Road Animal Hospital for two years. He always gets warm, thoughtful and professional care. Could not be happier with the team there
They always take such good care of our puppy Harrison.

Our puppy just had her 2nd round of vaccinations at Kingston Road Animal hospital and everything went GREAT! All of the staff were kind, friendly, attentive and efficient.  We're very grateful, and looking forward to returning next month!

Kingston Road Animal Hospital has been exceptional. From the moment you walk through the door, the team is prompt, compassionate, and caring. They treat every animal as if it were their own.

What I particularly appreciate is how knowledgeable and helpful they are with pet insurance. When you have a more medically complex pet, that guidance makes an enormous difference and provides peace of mind. They also have outstanding relationships with specialists and others in the veterinary community, ensuring your pet receives the very best care when needed.

As someone who has had dogs my entire life, the kindness, professionalism, and genuine love for animals shown by everyone at Kingston Road Animal Hospital is among the very best I’ve experienced. Our family couldn’t be happier with the care they provide, and I recommend them without hesitation.

Hello Aaruran! Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Kingston Road Animal Hospital. It’s our pleasure to care for your pet, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

-KRAH TEAM-

We are preparing for a big move and the team were very helpful in giving our dog a thorough exam and advice on a safe flight etc.
Thanks as always!

I am extremely pleased about all of the care my cat receives from the Kingston Road Animal Hospital.  All of the staff there, give excellent treatment for my cat.  All of the staff are extremely customer service friendly too, and all have genuine concern for my cats health, and my cat lives a happy life.  Everyone there , are always ready to assist.
The team at Kingston Road Animal Hospital is outstanding. Friendly, accommodating and extremely capable. They always meet my minds!

Hello Kayla! Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and the trust you've placed in our team. It's a privilege to care for Lucia Strawberry, and we look forward to seeing you again at your next visit!

-KRAH TEAM-

Wonderful service and caring staff
All good !   Thank you for following up!
The staff at Kingston Road Animal Hospital are fantastic.  They’re always amazing with my two cats.

I was able to get a same day appointment for my sick dog. He was seen right away. Dr Emma was very kind, compassionate and knowledgeable. Buddy is doing much better. We will definitely be back. Thank you for taking car of Buddy.

Hello Michael! Thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a positive experience. We look forward to serving you again soon!"

-KRAH TEAM-

Hello Justin! Thank you for the 5-star rating! Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care for every pet, and your support means a great deal to us. We look forward to caring for you and your pet again in the future!"

-KRAH TEAM-
Amazing service with a smile. Very professional and knowledgeable Vet

We loved our experience here. While this isn’t our home vet, they were able to squeeze us in last minute on a Saturday to see our senior doggy. From the minute we walked in, we were delightedly greeted. Everyone was so kind and helpful. Dr. Delgado was great and very knowledgeable. She ultimately helped solve our problem with our doggie without needing further tests. We are so happy we were able to get great care here. Highly recommend!

First time client (as my vet was not available). Everyone that I came in contact with was courteous, professional & had a positive attitude.

I was ushered into an examination room promptly (upon arrival), which was appreciated as most cats are known to have “white coat’s syndrome”.

The vet & vet techs provided the appropriate treatment & medication (without suggesting any unnecessary diagnostic tests, as it was obvious my cat was having a flare up of a longstanding medical issue).

I was very impressed that my claim was submitted to my insurer later that day. Thank you very much for squeezing us in on a Saturday!! It was very much appreciated!!
Fast and professional. It was a bit busy the last time we were there but I see how hard they all work.

Our visit to Kingston Road Animal Hospital was very good.  The staff was kind and friendly.  Dr. Delgado was very good with our dog and he was treated well.

The only suggestion that we have is that their floor cleaner should be something that is not so offensive to people and animals.  They were cleaning the floors with Pinesol when we arrived.  So many people have allergies and asthma and cannot tolerate strong scents.  If it is hard for people, I can't imagine what it is like for animals that have a much stronger sense of smell.
Always timely caring and professional service for my fur children BooBoo and ZooZoo

Emma was very pleasant to talk to and professional. She explained the examination thoroughly and detailed. I feel Major Tom is in good hands with her. Thanks,
David
Great team with valuable advice. Not pushy towards "selling" you a treatment that you want to do more research on. Very knowledgeable and helpful Dr!
Everyone at this clinic is so caring! It warms my heart to know that my sweet boy Felix is in loving hands.
They got us in quick when we needed it, were super welcoming and treated Brandy like she was one of theirs! Highly recommend
Was able to get an appointment same day. Very friendly team and always respectful around choices in care. Follow up is always wonderful for a check-in
Panko came back chipper with very polished teeth

The vet took my dog in on such short notice and provided excellent care for a small cut in the eye. The customer service was excellent, no wait time and they did a great job making sure my dog felt cared for. On a Saturday, for that type of quick and quality service was a blessing. Thank you!
Dr. CV new to the clinic was very attentive and understanding in our choice of care for our Maizy.
I was going to use a veterinarian closer to my home and then met Dr Culjat-Vukman and decided to stay. She was excellent!

Hi Michael, thank for you for the 5 star rating!

-KRAH TEAM-

Got a same day routine health check up appointment plus vaccine administration with ease. Didn't have to wait at all for my cat to be seen. Everyone was very friendly and patient at this Animal Hospital. I was informed of the fees upfront and the reasoning for the treatment plan was clearly explained to me beforehand. I will be bringing our cat back for her routine check ups for sure. I would happily recommend Kingston Road Animal Hospital to friends and neighbours.
Excellent care and support every time I interact with the Kingston Road Animal Hospital.

Thank you so much for accommodating Pickles so quickly yesterday, even though he was a new client. From the time I first called the clinic in a bit of a panic, to the time I walked out of the appointment with my mind at ease, was only an hour and a half - the speed was truly appreciated, and everyone I interacted with was professional, friendly and helpful. Thank you for making a stressful time easier!

I had a great experience with this veterinary clinic. The staff were incredibly kind, professional, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to explain everything thoroughly and made sure both I and my pet felt comfortable throughout the visit.

We had a wonderfulexperience at Kingston Road Animal Clinic. From the moment we arrived, the staff was kind, welcoming, and very attentive. Dr. Emma was absolutely exceptional—professional, compassionate, and thorough in her care. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure we felt comfortable with the treatment plan for our dog. Our dog Leo is usually very anxious. The doctor was kind and gentle, so Leo trusted her and went to her without hesitation.
It’s clear that everyone here truly cares about the animals and their well-being. The level of dedication and warmth we experienced made a stressful situation so much easier. We are very grateful and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent veterinary care.

Knowledgeable, helpful and friendly people! Staff and vets handled my pet with care and affection. Their free consult service was a very helpful starting point to maintain kitty’s eye health long term. Would recommend.

A huge thank you to this great team of specialists providing excellent care for our dog! They are reliable, compassionate and thorough. They take the time to answer questions, educate, and reassure us, pet owners, so that we can make the best health decisions for our furry babies.
The staff are very caring and kind.

Our cat Gerry is very skittish and terrified of the crate, vet, etc. but the staff here treat him so well, it makes it so much easier. They are all so wonderful and knowledgeable, the vet Emma took so much time to go through all of Gerry’s options and answer all of our questions. We travel pretty far to get here, it’s worth it! :-)

This is pixie. Pixie is very sensitive. Pixie was peeing and pooping all over places where there should never have been pee or poo. She was also yelling and screaming at us in the middle of the night which she does not usually do either. Our vet tech was absolutely lovely. They treated our cat with love and respect and dignity and provided Quick diagnostic information that was helpful And helped inform planning. Would definitely recommend this clinic

I ended up at Kingston Road Animal Hospital because my new rescue kitten was sick and my vet at the time wouldn’t see him. And what a blessing! Dr Degado welcomed us with kindness and wisdom, offered several approaches and figured out what was up. She and her staff followed up with several phone calls to see how Phoenix was doing which I so appreciated! This week we had another scare and Dr Degado took time on the phone to talk to me and answer my questions and suggested lovely Vet Tech Jessica help us out rather than a full exam. This was perfect. I feel so lucky Phoenix is in the care of Dr Degado who clearly loves animals and their families as do all the staff at Kingston Road. Thank you! Thank you!
Thanks Everyone at Kingston animal hospital Murphys feeling better right now !

The staff were very accommodating to see our little girl Ripley on short notice and did a fantastic job handling and examining her. They have been easy to work with in transferring care and medical documents from the shelter and are an easy recommendation to anyone living in the Kingston village neighborhood
Great staff who always take care of our pup.
Everyone was very kind

Went to the hospital on Saturday as our puppy was not feeling well due to a stomach upset for a few days. Previously, we did bring her to another clinic near our place, but they could'nt find out what happened.

KRAH is really good and was really worth the 30min trip here. The front desk staff (didnt get her name), was very polite and helpful. The nursing staff (didnt get her name), who saw our puppy before the doctor was really good. She tried to collect as much details as possible and spent a lot of time, asked really valid and relevant questions. Some of the things we had missed, we could tell them because of the way she asked the questions. Doctor Lucia Delgado referred to the detailed notes and was able to recommend the solution. She gave us some options to consider and gave the pros and cons for us to make an informed choice.

The front desk staff were very clear in communicating the medications and other options we could consider, without being pushy.

After the visit, my puppy is now fully recovered and is eating well.   We really appreciate all the staff at the hospital for helping our puppy get well so quickly. 🙏
Friendly staff, great working hours and really care about my dog!

Staff was so patient and accommodating for my Cashy’s cherry eye surgery. I even brought a shirt for my pups surgery (so my dog can have my scent with him through the procedure) and Caitlin offered to wash it for me in case of any accidents. My baby is very anxious so I’d absolutely recommend them to anyone who has an anxious or nervous animal!
Seny my dog for nail cutting and was prescribed me medication as of he suffers from anxiety. Thanks for the meds
Kingston Road Animal Hospital is excellent! They have always been responsive, caring, trustworthy, reasonable and I know they have my dog's best interest at heart.

Amazing team, phenomenal care for our good boy. We were well taken care of, and the approach to our dog's care during a vomiting "emergency" was well thought out and practical. Would recommend this vet to everyone.

Great experience!  I have been to Kingston Road Vet with many of our pets over the years. I am not a regular vet goer (don’t judge) and only seem to go when it’s an emergency.

This seemed to be one of those times again. Was able to get a same day appt which was amazing. The experience from arrival, meeting with technician, then having Dr assessment was fairly quick. Sent home with lots meds, lots of information and a great sense of knowing that Bruce was going to be ok.

The only issue I have (and this is with all vets) is the price. We all know it’s super expensive. It would be nice if you could either pay in installments or not have such a tiered system. You feel guilty if you don’t (or can’t afford) to pay top tier for service for everything your pet needs.

Our 4 year old xl bully has been getting all of her medical needs here since she was a pup. From annual vaccines, parasite meds and a very sad tail amputation we have never felt anything but comfortable and thankful. The staff take so much care in their craft and it makes the world of a difference when making hard decisions. Our dog loves to visit and hates to leave thanks to all the love ahead gets every visit.
Hello Parisa! Thanks so much for the wonderful rating. Have a great day! Warm regards, Fiona. Practice Manager
Great team they were very friendly and patient with my babIes . I would definitely recommend this clinic.1000%

KRAH took Logan in right away when he needed emergency dental surgery for some abscessed teeth. The staff were so friendly and attentive, especially Caitlin. I could tell he was well taken care of when he wouldn't leave her side when I came to pick him up 😅. He left with some pearly whites and a few less teeth, but in good spirits, and with some manicured nails! The surgery went so well, and he was back to his normal self in no time. The follow-up call the next morning was really appreciated! 5/5!

The Veterinarians and Vet Techs are super knowledgeable and excellent at what they do!  Both my cats go here and have had the best care. They are honest, reliable and I highly recommend them for any of your pets health needs.
Very accommodating vet clinic, very knowledgeable Dr. And kind staff. They helped my little guy with an eye issue. Prices seemed reasonable. Glad I tried them, will be back for sure.
Awesome experience with this vet service caring and compassionate will definitely make this my regular vet

Always a great experience with this clinic. Been taking my cats to them for years now.

We brought Tigger in to see Dr.Phong at Banks Animal Hospital.  I Googled ’Banks’ only to find out they are permanently closed.  So where the heck did muh cat go?  It’s now called ‘Kingston Road’.  I chuckled, she is in good hands.  Man!  She put up a fight to get her into her carrying case. Our cats go here if they act funny, sluggish.  I don’t know what they went and done, but she came home acting like Tigger.  Glad that there are great Vet’s still out there.

I Mr Snuggle Puff the Pug made it to my 12th birthday because of everyone at Kingston Road Animal Hospital … and I expect to celebrate many more !!
It was a scary time to suddenly find cancer growing on my back leg ! Mom took me daily to the beach while waiting for the surgery in case it didn’t work out, so I would have some fun in those 2 weeks, which Mom said felt like forever.
The guys at KRAH talked to Mom almost everyday and kept a close watch on me before my surgery and afterwards, for as long as Mom and I needed support ! They all were so caring with Mom with all her questions and worries.
I had my leg removed and can you believe, it hasn’t bothered me a bit! It has healed perfectly and the scar is tiny! It’s been almost 3 months now since the surgery and I am having such a great time going fast on my wheels all around the city exploring! Melissa, Malik, Trish, Caitlin, Jessica, Manroop, Dr.Emma and Dr. Lucia are special healing angels for animals I’m sure of it.
Corny I know but very true. I never get nervous going there for check up’s or even to just weigh myself to make sure I’m not eating too much or too little! They always welcome me with smiles and cuddles. I love them and so does my Mom …she keeps saying this word … grateful 🩷

This place is owned by VetStrategy, an international conglomerate that is consolidating Vet Clinics within Canada. They are purely for $, and are letting go Vets that are actually fair and honest about what to charge you. Absolutely horrible place. Please consider this when giving them your business.

Overall great service: always available to answer my questions and address my concerns, punctual, precise and provided me with professional follow ups after the surgery. Everybody seemed to take good care of my cat: no issues at all with the surgical operation.
I hope I will not have to see them again (obviously, as I hope my cat will be fine for the years to come), but I feel like totally recommending this place.
Thanks to all of the staff for taking care of Olaf.

Thanks for leaving us a great 4-star review! We’re pleased you had a good experience. Let us know how we can make your next visit even better!"

Really appreciated that they were able to see our pup on the same day that we called. Everyone was very attentive and efficient, and the vet was ready with a plan to treat our sick little guy and open to listening to all of our questions. Her confidence and clear communication was very reassuring and eased the stress we had been feeling due to our pup being sick. Thank you to the Kingston Road Animal Hospital.

I ve been taking my now 5 year old Lab Charlie to Kingston Road animal hospital and every experience has been amazing . From surgery on his paw to regular checkups  the staff have been exceptional with care and treatment and always advise costs prior to doing a treatment as well as if there are other options . Highly recommend you take your pet there .
They took my puppy (dooneh) here, and all staff are so friendly and helpful; highly recommended.
They took great care of my cat! Very informative and helpful with answering all our questions.

Prudence loves the affection and care she gets from the team at Kingston Road Animal Hospital. I love the professionalism and willingness to listen when we come in with an issue. I also appreciate the fact that the team seems to care about me as much as they do about my dog. That's rare. Special shout out to Dr. Delgado and all the vet techs. Prudence never wants to leave after she has spent some time with you guys!

We have been bringing our Doberman, Rocky, to Kingston Road for several years and couldn’t be happier with the care he receives. The staff consistently go above and beyond- whether it’s handling his nail trims with patience or managing his annual vaccinations with kindness and professionalism. We would highly recommend them to any pet owner!

From the moment I arrived, everyone showed a lack of interest in my pet. Later, when the “doctor” attended me, they took my dog and left me waiting without telling me what was happening. When she came back, she only showed me a sheet with the price for some tests that I never requested. Then she left again and returned with another sheet showing a lower price just for medications, which I accepted. She left and I never saw her again; in fact, it was her assistant who handed me the medications, and I still had many questions about how to administer them.

In total, from the moment I arrived until I left, I spoke with the “doctor” for only about two minutes. They did not provide any real care; they only want to charge you as much as possible, and they do not care about your pet. That same day I went to another clinic where they were very kind and helped me a lot. Today my pet is doing very well.

I do not recommend this clinic at all. They just want your money and take advantage of you when you are worried about your pet. If this review is useful for people who are looking for a clinic for their pets, please look for better options. This is the worst clinic that exists, and unfortunately I had to learn that from the bad experience I went through.

The technician and vet are always kind with my dog. They are attentive and recommend appropriate care for any concerns, whether it’s to keep an eye out for potential changes or to taking a deeper look. I’m  quite happy with Kingston Road Animal Hospital.
Love this vet. Knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend.

Thank you for the 5 stars! 🌟 We’re so glad you had a positive experience with us.

Very overpriced. My dog had a rash on his leg and the vet examined it. She confirmed it was a rash and charged me $160 for telling me information I already knew. They wanted to give my dog antibiotics which brought the total up to $400. I just paid the $160 and left with my dog. I’ll put coconut oil on his rash and let it heal. Did you become a vet to help the animals or your pockets?

The team at Kingston Read Animal Hospital have been exceptional.  I have been taking one of my cats here for several years to treat a urinary condition, and the staff here have always been knowledgeable, friendly and supportive of all his trails and tribulations.  I especially appreciate that they are conscious of the cost of vet care, and make pains to deliver the most cost effective treatments to help my little fur gremlin live a healthy and happy life.
Caring and professional.
Phenomenal team, very caring, very attentive, and accommodating for their patients. Have had great experiences with their entire team and have always been integrity driven and transparent.

Always a very pleasant experience right from the moment I walked in..Very thorough examination and explained every step along the way..And gave me options on the treatment being   administered rhat suited my budget.. Would recommend this clinic hands down..
Wonderful caring place and they spent a lot of time with us answering our questions about our new kitties as we have never had pets before. Highly recommend!

They knew how to deal with my reactive dog incredibly well and I didn't have to drug her up like my last veterinary place I used. Nice and small and the staff were great. I've found my new place to take my dog and cat to. I highly recommend this place!

The team here was so helpful and reassuring when my cat needed to have surgery. The staff were patient and kind when I had questions during her healing process and were available to discuss medication side effects and recovery plans when I was anxious about her healing.

She treats my dog with so much care and creates a comfortable environment for me and my family. The receptionist is also very understanding and sweet. We live 2 hours away, but honestly the drive is worth the love and care these people provide. 100% coming here.

Hi there! Thank you so much for this very kind rating! If there is anything that we could have done to create a better experience, please feel free to contact us at 416-690-0625 or reception@vetstoronto.com

We visited Kingston Road Animal Hospital for the first time, as the sister clinic to our regular vet, where we were unable to immediately see someone. My dog loves attention from people but does not like to be examined at the vet. He is scared when being "poked and prodded" and backs away when any medical instrument comes out. Caitlin, the vet tech, instantly made Rowan feel comfortable when she started howling with him! ;) She sat on the floor with him and showed him so much love and attention. Dr. Culjat-Vukman joined Caitlin on the floor and also poured on the affection! Rowan was in heaven and didn't even notice the stethoscope on his chest! And although he balked at the underarm thermometer, Dr. C-V was able to sneak his temperature while Caitlin was distracting him with more love. In May 2024, I took my dog to Kingston Road Animal Hospital seeking advice. Dr. Pusong recommended an X-ray, blood test, and ultrasound. The diagnosis revealed that my dog had liver cancer, which caused difficulties in eliminating fluids from his body. Consequently, I requested fluid to be drained. We also discovered a tumor near his heart. Dr. Pusong prescribed a medication called Furosemide.

Unfortunately, the medication was not effective. A month and a half later, I returned to the hospital to drain the fluid again. Dr. Pusong informed me that my dog needed another X-ray. When I questioned why, considering we had already paid over $1500 for an ultrasound and X-ray a month prior, he explained that he wasn’t certain which organ was retaining fluid. I decided against another X-ray, as it seemed unnecessary. He took my dog into another room and later returned with a small tube containing about 3 ml of fluid, stating that because I refused the X-ray, he could only drain that limited amount. I ended up paying $390 for that visit.

A week later, my dog had his first seizure. I rushed him to the emergency vet and requested that they drain the fluid again. I inquired if he needed X-rays, and the emergency vet informed me that there was no need for that since he had already undergone an ultrasound. I was taken aback by this revelation. The emergency vet advised me to stop the medication, as it was damaging my dog's kidneys—information that Dr. Pusong had not shared regarding the side effects.

I returned to Kingston Road Animal Hospital to drain the fluid again, as I couldn't find another animal hospital at that moment. I had already booked with another vet, and make sure Dr. Pusong wasn’t available that day, I allowed her to proceed without requesting another X-ray. This time, my dog was a pound lighter.

I decided to go VCA Scarborough Animal Hospital, where the costs were reasonable—only $240—and they didn’t charge me any visit fee since they knew I’d be coming back regularly. And never asked for any X-ray because they got all my dog's record from Kingston Animals hospital .

I’m sharing this experience to let fellow dog lovers know that Dr. Pusong took advantage of our love and care for our pets. Initially, I thought I had found a good veterinarian because Dr. Pusong seemed friendly and explained things thoroughly. If I hadn’t taken my dog to the emergency vet, I might not have realized that Dr. Pusong was attempting to take advantage of me financially during my dog’s final months.
